title: Hosted API: Enterprise Priority Orchestration for Chat, Streaming, Tool Calls, and Structured Outputs
creator: Sophie Kim
description: Define and finalize an operational policy and scoring rubric for intake, triage, and prioritization of enterprise feature requests targeting Hosted API capabilities: streaming chat, function/tool calling, and structured outputs. Outcome should be a repeatable matrix used by PMs and SEs to route requests (self-serve roadmap, sales-qualified, or enterprise-engineering), estimate resourcing impact, and trigger SLA/contract discussions.
acceptance_criteria: A documented prioritization matrix that assigns each incoming request to one of: self-serve backlog, rapid shipable feature, dedicated enterprise lane, or 'decline/educate'.
Scoring rubric with weights for: customer revenue/ARR, security/compliance sensitivity, latency/availability SLA needs, engineering effort (approx. story points), and strategic alignment.
A lightweight intake form template for Sales/Support to collect required data fields (usage patterns, PII scope, compliance requirements, desired SLOs, expected traffic).
Integration tiles in the Hosted API intake Confluence page and a recommended routing flow for SEs to open ENG or PM tickets with prefilled fields.
Pilot triage on 8 recent enterprise requests (including three live customer examples) and documented outcomes + rationale.
decision_log: 2026-03-10 Sophie Kim: Kickoff — agreed scope includes only non-bug feature requests for Hosted API (chat streaming, tool/function calling, structured outputs). Excludes infra-only or Dedicated capacity contract negotiations unless they change API semantics.

2026-03-11 Diego Alvarez: Proposed scoring weights: Revenue 30%, Security/Compliance 25%, SLA Complexity 20%, Eng Effort 15%, Strategic Alignment 10%. Note: weights are provisional; requested feedback from Sales and Security.
2026-03-12 Security review (input from Priya Rao): For any request with PII or regulated-data classification, escalate to 'enterprise lane' regardless of revenue score. Marked as safety gate.

2026-03-13 PM/SE sync: Adopted revised weights: Revenue 25%, Security/Compliance 30%, SLA Complexity 20%, Eng Effort 15%, Strategic Alignment 10%. Agreed to include a binary 'requires private deployment' flag that forces enterprise lane.
2026-03-13 Diego Alvarez: Decided on routing outcomes mapping: score >= 70 => Enterprise lane; 45-69 => PM backlog with canary experiment; <45 => self-serve/educational follow-up.
2026-03-13 Sophie Kim: Approved intake form fields and embedded examples. Ready for pilot triage next week.
updates: 2026-03-10 Sophie Kim: Created ticket and circulated initial proposed rubric to Sales and Security. Asked Sales to gather three representative enterprise asks for pilot.

2026-03-11 Marta Kowalski: Submitted three enterprise requests with usage forecasts and desired SLOs (attached). Note: two requests explicitly require server-side tool-calling and one requires structured JSON outputs for billing reconciliation.
2026-03-12 Priya Rao: Flagged request #2 as regulated (GDPR + finance PII). Recommended private deployment or obfuscated outputs; escalated to Security review queue.
2026-03-12 Diego Alvarez: Updated scoring weights after PM/SE sync and added 'private deployment' gate. Uploaded revised matrix to Confluence.

2026-03-13 Sophie Kim: Ran pilot triage on three requests; outcomes: one -> enterprise lane, one -> PM backlog with canary, one -> self-serve with mitigation guidance. Documented rationale per scoring categories in Confluence.
next_steps: Pilot the intake form for two weeks with Sales and CS; capture time-to-decision and false-positive/negative rates.
Work with Engineering (ENG-4810) to define minimal engineering spike for enterprise lane requests to assess feasibility and cost estimates.
Add a checklist for Security gating and update the 'enterprise lane' runbook with steps for Private deployment onboarding.
Schedule a review with Legal to ensure intake form collects necessary contract/SLA info for enterprise negotiations.
Ship Confluence page updates and notify regional Sales hubs (NA/EU/APAC) of the new intake flow.
